import std.measurements

record Sample { mut reading: Measurement<TemperaturePoint> }

fn main() -> Void {
    mut sample = Sample { reading: Measurement<TemperaturePoint> {
        value: temperature_point(20.0, "degC"), sources: [], known: false,
        reason: "sensor " + "offline"
    } }
    alias = sample
    sample.reading = Measurement<TemperaturePoint> {
        value: temperature_point(30.0, "degC"), sources: [], known: false,
        reason: "replacement " + "offline"
    }
    print(alias.reading.value)
    print(sample.reading.value)
    print(alias.reading.reason)
    drop(alias)
    drop(sample)
}
